definitions.explanation: A person who serves on a committee or board.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学級|がっきゅう}→学級：12253_gakkyuu⟧{委員|いいん}です。
{委員|いいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれました→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was elected as a committee member.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧{委員|いいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To serve as an executive committee member.

notes:
{委員|いいん} refers to a member of a committee or board.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {委員|いいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (become a committee member)
- {委員|いいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧ (serve as a committee member)
- {委員|いいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (be elected as a committee member)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧: committee (the group itself)
- {委員長|いいんちょう}: committee chairman
- ⟦{学級|がっきゅう}→学級：12253_gakkyuu⟧{委員|いいん}: class representative
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧{委員|いいん}: executive committee member
